title: YoungTunes - Music & Videos
full_description: The Player is a music player  for Android.Young Tunes will guide you easily to find all the music in your phone and download music from your Cloud Drive(Dropbox and Onedrive).quick searches all music and audio filesPlay audio track from local devicesEasy to support all music & audio file formats.You can manage your musics easily, Display play/pause, skip forward and stop in notification status.Headset/Bluetooth Controls.Lockscreen control support.Playlist shuffle, repeat modes and repeat one.Background music playback.
